text: You wake up in a dark cave and have no idea how you got there.
The only light you can see is in the distance from the mouth of the cave.
You see a treasure chest close by and you walk up to it and open it.
Inside you find swords that seemed to be enchanted!
The passage narrows until your shoulders scrape both walls.
Something ahead of you decides it has been patient long enough.
The floor here is white with old bones, and none of them are small.
You are not the first to walk this way, and something notices that you are.
Black water fills the passage to your knees, cold enough to ache.
The ripples ahead are not being made by you.
Pale fungus lights the walls, and the air tastes of copper.
Something that has been eating well here turns to look at you.
The passage opens into a chamber with more ways out than you would like.
One drops steeply into the dark. One climbs towards a draught of clean air.
A dry shelf of rock, a ring of cold ashes, and no way in but the one you used.
Someone else stopped here once. They did not stay.
The floor falls away into a chamber that swallows the sound of your landing.
You are not alone down here, and whatever it is has been waiting.
A hollow the size of a cathedral, and every surface of it moves slightly.
One piece of the dark detaches itself and comes for you.
A chasm splits the floor, and the ledge around it is barely a ledge.
Something is already on the ledge with you.
You see that there are two paths you can take.
One way leads down a path with shimmering light.
The other is the way out of the cave.
You head down the path of shimmering light.
The glow is not treasure. It is something breathing.
Past the body, the shimmer resolves into a narrow alcove.
You take the safe way, and the light widens ahead of you.
You exit the cave into a forest.
You walk out into the forest.
You see a distant castle in the distance.
You decide to make your way towards it.
As your walking you notice an Ogre standing in your way, but
he has not noticed you yet.

exits.label: Sneak
exits.sneakSuccessText: You were able to sneak past the Ogre

text: A track worn into the forest floor, going the way you want to go.
Tracks are made by something, and this one is still being used.
The trees give out into a clearing that is far too quiet.
The quiet ends.
Standing stones lean out of the moss, older than the forest around them.
Something has made a home in the middle of them.
A hollow where the canopy closes over completely and the light gives up.
You hear it before you see it.
The undergrowth tears at you the whole way, and it takes hours.
But nothing in here is large enough to be a problem, and you come out
on the far side scratched, tired, and entirely alive.
Up further on the path you see a fountain.
The water looks as if it is flowing with some magical essence.
You approach cautiously.
You make a fire where the trees thin, and watch the castle not get closer.
The ground begins to rise beyond here.
The forest lets go of the slope and the wind takes over.
The castle sits above you now, and everything between here and it is bare rock.
A cairn of stacked stones, each one carried up here by somebody.
Whatever they were marking is still here.
Loose scree slides under every step, and the drop beside you is long.
Something up the slope starts moving down it.
A black tarn sits in a bowl of rock, flat and wrong and entirely still.
The stillness breaks.
The gorge is sheltered, slower, and takes you the long way around.
You reach the far end unbothered, but the light has gone while you walked.
A shrine of black stone, roofless, facing the castle gates.
Someone built this to look at what you are about to walk into.
The last shelter before the walls: a fold of rock, out of the wind.
There will not be another one.
The trees thin, and the castle stands over you at last.
The gates are open. Nothing has tried to stop you, and that is worse.
The courtyard is full of armour that nobody is wearing any more.
Something in it is still standing up.
A hall long enough that you cannot see the end of it.
The doors at the far end are already opening for you.
